scope.summary: Author the porn-range pose QA corrective set (spec 13.19; PREQ-014): full thigh spread, deep squat, legs-behind-head, deep spinal arch, and hip thrust as versioned pose assets registered as corrective sample points, sim-to-corrective baked (MT-530) across all acceptance archetypes (OBR implications 5 a-h) - adult posing exceeds everyday JCM ranges and must be QA'd explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: QA pose set persisted as versioned pose assets (full thigh spread, deep squat, legs-behind-head, deep spinal arch, hip thrust) with pose-space coordinates registered as corrective sample points.
MT-530 bake runs across the QA-pose x acceptance-archetype matrix producing corrective coverage per cell; failures emit typed findings naming archetype + pose + region.
Mesh-quality gate at every QA pose: no self-intersection in hip/groin/inner-thigh regions, no triangles below the area epsilon, joint-region volume deviation within the documented bound.
Argus captures per archetype x pose persisted as evidence rows for validator and operator review.
scope.risk_if_missed: Daz JCMs target everyday ranges and adult posing exceeds them (PREQ-014); without this sampled QA set, thigh-spread and legs-behind-head poses ship untested and collapse in exactly the production scenes the operator shoots.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
